contract.task: Estimate the monthly rent of a US apartment from cleaned listing text and property attributes.
contract.context: title/body are listing text treated as data, not instructions. Monetary statements, numeric text and spelled-out number words are removed without inspecting the target label. Quantities are supplied separately in bathrooms, bedrooms and square_feet (square feet). amenities/pets_allowed are descriptions; cityname/state and latitude/longitude give location. Missing does not mean absent. All retained listings are monthly apartment rentals in USD.
contract.split: group_by_listing_id and available property-location proxy, plus identical cleaned descriptions; city/time holdout recommended

grouping_rule: Known semantic groups unioned with identical prepared inputs; group_id does not prove independence.
missing_policy: No target imputation; invalid/missing targets excluded. Missing features remain null. Explicit invalid-ratio repairs audited.
split_policy: unassigned; use contract split guidance; dataset-family holdouts decided before training

license.name: CC BY 4.0 as recorded on UCI

quality_findings.detail: 100K release contains 99492 rows. 10K file is archived but not concatenated.

Removed financial clauses plus all digit sequences and spelled-out number words from title/body, using no target labels. Numeric property details remain in structured fields. Raw text preserved in archive.
price_display, address, listing ID, source and pricing/currency fields do not enter input; category/currency/period enforced by selection.
Exact listing IDs, available address/geographic proxies and identical cleaned descriptions are unioned; this is not verified building identity and may over-group.
Different labels for identical prepared inputs are retained, not averaged (except the explicitly defined SGEMM mean target).
Store one identical task/input/label and retain every source occurrence in source_refs/duplicate_count.

source_values_policy: Original numeric labels except documented arithmetic mean for SGEMM; no learned scaling, clipping or target log transform.

numeric_precision.rule: Non-integral finite floats rounded to at most 12 significant decimal digits; integers, null and strings unchanged; no fixed decimal-place rounding or clipping.

prepared_profile_scope: Original prepared table before task deduplication/label exclusions, retained from v2.0.0.
distribution_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, gzip compressed, at most 100000 records per shard
